name: ship
place: A wooden merchant sailing ship at sea at early morning: a long plank deck with low wooden railings on both sides, stacked cargo crates and barrels on the left, a big wooden steering wheel on the right near the stern, one tall mast with furled sails ahead, and a small green island with a white lighthouse on the horizon far ahead.

captain.look: A sea captain as people picture old sailing-ship captains: a tall man in a long dark blue coat with brass buttons, a black tricorn hat, high leather boots, a brass spyglass in his belt.
captain.face: He has a long weathered face, deep-set grey eyes, bushy white eyebrows, a hooked nose, a thick white beard and a scar across his left cheek.

sailor.look: A young deck sailor as people picture old sailors: a striped red and white shirt, loose canvas trousers, a red headscarf, bare feet, a coil of rope over his shoulder.
sailor.face: He has a round freckled face, wide-set green eyes, thin light eyebrows, a small snub nose, a gap-toothed grin and short messy ginger hair.
